description: This file provides database interaction and data management functions for a mobile service website backend, including schema initialization, listing services, managing bookings, and seeding seed data in a Supabase/Postgres environment.

methods.name: str _table(name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the database table name with schema if provided, considering public schema rules.

methods.name: Any _sb()
methods.description: Returns a cached Supabase client instance for executing queries.

methods.name: Any _sb_exec(query)
methods.description: Executes a Supabase query, normalizing the response data and raising an error if present.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_seeded()
methods.description: Performs seed data insertion for device brands, models, and repair services if not already seeded.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, including verifying configuration and seeding catalog data.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available repair services for the front-end display.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Retrieves repair services for booking flow options.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Provides list of device brands for the booking flow.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Returns device models associated with a given brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches key-value site content entries from the database.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer request record and returns its ID.

methods.name: str create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking with user details and returns the UUID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection( booking_id: str, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )
methods.description: Updates a booking's device/ service selections and returns the updated record.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Lists recent bookings with optional limit.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a booking by its identifier.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent booking associated with a phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of a booking.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Checks admin username and password against environment variables.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: update_booking_device_selection
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: str, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
